name: Frontier training compute
summary: The biggest published AI training runs measure how much compute went into teaching one frontier model. That compute has grown roughly three- to four-fold per year for about a decade — each year the largest runs are much larger than the year before. Future rates are uncertain: chip supply, cost, and policy can slow or speed the climb. The chart counts floating-point operations (FLOPs) for one training run — higher means a bigger training job.
